_what: Run 2's save edit E2, after the Cologne Case (between P17a and P17b; playthrough-guide.md parts 7 and 9). Items: x99 each of Joy, Excite and Vivid Scent (snatcherLeo, 2026-10-19); one each of the bag-only item paths the story never gives: Sacred Ash, a Sun Stone, an Oran Berry, a Repel (snatcherLeo, 2026-10-20); an Everstone for the evolution tests (the Rare Candies come from E1's x99: a recipe sets a count, so listing them here would lower it). Pokemon (snatcherLeo, 2026-10-20: evolution methods, legal and checked against the disc): Sunkern Lv 5 (Sun Stone, kind 7), Azurill Lv 5 at friendship 220 holding the Everstone (friendship, kind 1; Everstone), three Tyrogue Lv 19 (Atk > Def, Atk = Def, Atk < Def: kinds 8, 9, 10). P17a must end with ONE Pokemon in the party: the editor adds to free party slots only.

add_pokemon._note: Sunkern: Absorb (level-up); evolves with the Sun Stone (kind 7, item 93)
Azurill: Splash, Charm (level-up); friendship 220 (kind 1 needs 220+); holds the Everstone first
Tyrogue, Lonely (+Atk -Def): Attack > Defense -> Hitmonlee (kind 8) at Lv 20
Tyrogue, Hardy (neutral): Attack = Defense -> Hitmontop (kind 9) at Lv 20
Tyrogue, Bold (+Def -Atk): Attack < Defense -> Hitmonchan (kind 10) at Lv 20
